messages:
Maria: Heads-up — Compliance asked for a full export of routing & quota changes for the last 90 days. They want a clear "who changed what" with before/after. How do we want to surface this (console timeline + export) and what API shape should we expose?

Sanjay: We should export as NDJSON events, one line per change with a tiny diff payload. Easier for downstream consumers and streaming. Example line:
```json
{"ts":"2026-02-28T22:18:03Z","actor":"olivia","action":"modify","resource":"routing_policy","id":"rp_42","diff":[{"op":"replace","path":"/rules/1/priority","old":2,"new":5}],"meta":{"env":"prod","request_id":"req_abc123"}}
```
Note: redact secret fields server-side.

Kai: Agree NDJSON for exports. Two UX asks: 1) in-console timeline we should anchor the diff to the exact UI element (so product can show inline "changed from X to Y"), and 2) include a compact preview in the timeline so security reviewers don't have to download the full export.

Olivia: For the console preview, we should show field-level highlights and a link "Download full audit export" that starts a background job. We also need an option: "include full object snapshots" vs "diff-only" — legal might push for snapshots.

Sanjay: Snapshot option is ok but expensive. Implementation idea: stream NDJSON from a background job that reads the changefeed and materializes snapshots for actions flagged as "snapshot_required". API proposal:
```http
POST /v1/audit/exports
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "since":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "until":"2026-03-31T23:59:59Z",
  "format":"ndjson",
  "include_snapshots": false,
  "filters": {"resource": ["routing_policy","quota_rule"], "actor": ["olivia"]}
}
```
Response: job id + SSE/WS updates.

Kai: Need retention/PII rules baked into that job. E.g., fields to redact: api_key, kms_key_id, svc_account.credentials. Also add a policy param to drop IPs unless compliance explicitly requests them.

Olivia: Product question — should the export UI default to "diff-only" and require an explicit checkbox for snapshots with a warning about cost and sensitivity?

Maria: Yes default to diff-only + checkbox for snapshots + require an approval flow for snapshots at org level (like a toggle in settings). Also ensure job emits telemetry: tokens processed, bytes, and estimated completion. We have to be careful about telemetry volume hitting Prometheus. Chunking + export summary is better.

Sanjay: Implementation details: background worker will create a manifest file in the org's export bucket + chunked NDJSON parts. Streaming endpoint will stream parts as gzipped NDJSON. Also add a small schema for diffs so consumers can parse reliably (fields: ts, actor, action, resource, id, diff, snapshot_ref).

Maria: For the audit API, we should also make sure the RBAC check is done server-side. Only org admins or approved compliance roles can request snapshots. Non-admins get diff-only.

Kai: One more: changefeed ordering. If a policy was changed multiple times in-window, we should include sequence numbers so downstream can reconstruct history deterministically. Suggest adding a monotonic "seq" per-org per-resource.

Olivia: UX: in the timeline, clicking a change should show a compact diff, sequence number, who triggered it, and a link to "trace request" that opens the trace in tracing UI. That will help audits.

audit-bot: export job queued: job_id=job_20260228_77, owner=maria, filters={resource:[routing_policy,quota_rule]}, format=ndjson, include_snapshots=false

Maria: Thanks — I'll add the API draft to the RFC and ping legal/infosec for redaction rules. We should sync with infra on expected IO/cost for snapshots.

Sanjay: I will stub the worker and manifest format. Will follow up with a PR for the API contract.

Olivia: I'll do the console mockups for the timeline+preview.

Kai: I'll write a checklist for redaction + sequence-numbering and drop it into this thread later.

Maria: Perfect. If anyone needs examples of the existing changefeed shape, ping me and I'll attach extracts (redacted).
